gold_own_risk: very high, about 50% within 365 days; agrees with the flag but says the 0.5-0.7 band understates the risk
candidate_own_risk: very high, about 45%; agrees partly, says the score understates the risk

key_points.point: Verdict real risk, very high risk (~50%); agrees with the flag but the model band (4% bankrupt) understates the risk
PortoCem $79.1m guarantee missed, giving debenture holders the right to declare early maturity; acceleration of substantially all debt would leave the company without enough liquidity
Company expects to fail first-lien and fixed-charge covenants for Q3 2025
Revolver fully drawn ($710.4m loans + $19.5m L/Cs), no backup liquidity
Maturity wall: if the $511m 2026 Notes are not dealt with, about $5.0bn more springs due July-August 2026
Large loss: annualized net income -$1.51bn (-12.6% of assets), mostly non-cash ~$700m impairments, but cash earnings turned negative (-$374m) in H1 2025 after positive FY2022-FY2024
Operating cash burn: Q2 OCF -$352m; $551m unrestricted cash lasts ~4.7 months at Q2 burn (less with capex)
Distress signals: financial advisor retained for strategic alternatives, L/C facility rolled week by week then to 2025-11-14, NT 10-K and two NT 10-Qs, Nasdaq notices, material weaknesses
Evidence against: no payment missed (Defaults Upon Senior Securities: None), lenders keep waiving (Aug 7 debenture waiver, L/C facility committed)
Evidence against: Jamaica sold for $1.055bn, $98.6m escrow, Puerto Rico claim and up to $110m from Genera; positive book equity, CEO bought shares in Oct 2024 offering, most loss non-cash

contradictions: Prior-year annualized net income: CANDIDATE gives -$60.4M, GOLD gives -$70M.

Peer ranks differ in basis and value: GOLD ranks net income, operating income and OCF as the lowest of 144 peers (in dollars), CANDIDATE puts them at the 9th-12th percentile of 147 peers; revenue 9th percentile vs GOLD 33rd (in $) / 8th (as % of assets); current liabilities 86th vs GOLD 70th ($) / 88th (% of assets).
extra_points_in_candidate: Going concern doubt presented as the first main reason, with the exact Note 2 wording
Debt fair value $5,785M vs $9,088M carrying at year-end 2024 as a market signal of restructuring
GMLP preferred dividend not paid on 2025-05-15
PortoCem downgrade trigger suspended through August 30, 2026
Term Loan A commitments are zero
Only about $80M of cash and liquidity estimated at 2024-09-30
$2.73B New 2029 Notes at 12.000% with springing maturity
summary: CANDIDATE reaches the same verdict and nearly the same risk level as GOLD (real risk, very high, ~45% vs ~50%) and covers the critical filing evidence: the missed PortoCem guarantee, the expected covenant breach, the fully drawn revolver and the advisor hire. It gives less weight to the size of the ~$5bn springing maturity wall, the negative cash-earnings trend, and the weekly L/C rollovers and late filings, and has minor differences in prior-year net income and peer ranks.
